cases.question: According to Python itertools.groupby documentation, does it group equal keys anywhere in the input or only consecutive runs, and how should input be prepared to collect all equal keys together?
original_facets: Does itertools.groupby group equal keys anywhere in the input or only consecutive runs?
How should input be prepared to collect all equal keys together?
Check false premise: does the documentation actually state this behavior?
question_conditions: Prepare by grouping/sorting samekey for all-equal-keycollection

source_refs.title: Python Itertools and Functools Exercises: 20 Coding Problems with Solutions

claims.claim_text: groupby() groups only consecutive identical keys; it does not sort the data.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: Critical rule: groupby() groups only consecutive identical keys – it does not sort the data.

gold.reason: Consecutive grouping and no selfsorting supported.

claims.claim_text: groupby is a streaming operation that does not look ahead or back, so only adjacent elements with the same key are grouped together.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: It is a streaming operation – it does not look ahead or back, so only adjacent elements with the same key are grouped together.

gold.reason: Streaming adjacentgrouping supported in source. Interpret no lookahead as no global/nonadjacent grouping, not a guarantee of zero internal bufferednextitem reads; literalzeropeek is not established.

claims.claim_text: To collect all equal keys together, sort by the grouping key first with sorted(data, key=...) before passing to groupby().

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: Always sort by the grouping key first with sorted(data, key=...) before passing to groupby().

gold.reason: Correct all-equal-keycollection conditionalpreparation; do not strengthen into universalmandatorysorting.

claims.claim_text: The consecutive-only grouping is intentional and efficient, but it means the data must be pre-sorted on the grouping key.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: This is intentional and efficient, but it means the data must be pre-sorted on the grouping key.

gold.reason: Consecutive grouping works on unsortedinput; mandatorypresorting is only for all-equal-keycollection, not everyvaliduse. Exactthirdpartyquote does not make it universallytrue.

cases.question: В CPython 3.13 free-threaded режим без GIL экспериментальный или стабильный, включён ли по умолчанию и нужен ли отдельный executable?
original_facets: Статус free-threaded режима без GIL в CPython 3.13: экспериментальный или стабильный (PEP 703)
Включён ли free-threaded режим по умолчанию в CPython 3.13
Нужен ли отдельный executable/сборка для free-threaded режима в CPython 3.13

source_refs.title: Python 3.13: Free Threading and a JIT Compiler
Provide downloadable free-threaded macOS builds for Python 3.13 #120098

claims.claim_text: Free threading вводится как экспериментальная функция и не входит в официальную сборку Python; для отключения GIL нужна собственная сборка.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: Experimental: Free threading is introduced as an experimental feature and isn’t a part of the official Python distribution. You must make a custom Python build to disable the GIL.

gold.reason: Experimental component true; mandatorycustombuild/noofficialdistribution false for pinned3.13official Windows/macOSinstaller options. Fullconjunctionfalse despite exactstalequote.

claims.claim_text: Функция по-прежнему считается экспериментальной, поэтому её поддержка не устанавливается по умолчанию, а предлагается отдельной опцией установки.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: Because this feature is still considered experimental, the support for it is not installed by default. It is packaged as a separate install option, available by clicking the Customize button on the Installation Type step of the installer as described above.

gold.reason: Experimental component true. Notinstalledbydefault/installoption belongs macOSinstallerissue, not universal runtime enableddefault; wholeclaim lacks platformspecificqualifier.

claims.claim_text: При выборе этой опции устанавливается отдельный PythonT.framework рядом с обычным Python.framework.

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: When selected, a separate PythonT.framework will also be installed alongside the normal Python.framework in /Library/Frameworks.

gold.reason: PythonT.framework and alongsideframework installation true for describedmacOSinstaller, unqualified generalCPythonanswer omits thatscope; framework alone not separateexecutable proof.

claims.claim_text: Обычная сборка Python не поддерживает free threading, а специальная free-threaded сборка имеет ABI с меткой «t».

own_quotes.offset_unit: Unicode code points in original extracted text
own_quotes.quote: The vanilla Python build won’t support free threading, while the special free-threaded flavor will have a slightly different Application Binary Interface (ABI) tagged with the letter “t” for threading.

gold.reason: Ownsourcequote explicitly distinguishes vanilla andspecial free-threadedbuild with ABI t; supports separatebuildrequirement.
